# Data Sources — [COUNTRY]

Documentation of all external datasets for the [COUNTRY] gap analysis.

> **Location:** All raw data in `data/[CC]/raw/`. Never edited manually.

---

## 1. GBIF Occurrence Cubes (SQL API)

**Status:** Not yet downloaded

Submit the SQL query from `scripts/01a_download_raw_data.R` at
https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/download/sql with `countrycode = '[CC]'`.

Replace `[CC]` with your ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

| Resolution | Download Key | DOI |
|-----------|-------------|-----|
| 10 km | — | — |
| 50 km | — | — |

Files to place:
```
data/[CC]/raw/cubes/
├── cube_10km.csv
└── cube_50km.csv
```

---

## 2. EEA Reference Grids (shared)

> **Note:** EEA grids cover Europe only. For non-European countries, use
> ISEA3H hexagonal grids via the `dggridR` package (see ROADMAP Phase 3).

Shared across all European countries in `data/shared/grids/`.
The pipeline clips to your country's extent automatically.

Download from:
- 10km: https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/datastore/public?path=/eea_v_3035_10_km_eea-ref-grid-europe_p_2011_v01_r00
- 50km: https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/data/aac8379a-5c4e-445c-b2ef-23a6a2701ef0

```
data/shared/grids/
├── Grid_ETRS89-LAEA_10K.shp (+ .dbf, .prj, .shx)
└── EEA_50km_grid_v2024.gpkg
```

---

## 4. Administrative Boundaries (GADM)

Downloaded automatically via `geodata` package when
`admin_boundaries.enabled: true` in the config.

```
data/[CC]/raw/admin/
├── admin_level1.gpkg
└── admin_level2.gpkg
```

## Setup

```r
Sys.setenv(GBIF_GAP_COUNTRY = "[CC]")
source("scripts/01a_download_raw_data.R")
```
